-Winners will be picked in about 3 days (09/19/2017). Time is not set. Also, I might end it later than in 3 days depending on how many players entered the giveaway etc..
If you're already premium, you can enter for someone else, but nobody is allowed to enter twice. If someone's name is posted twice, the user only will be counted once.
-Please spell all names correctly.
